engine.magick.description:
JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, APNG, PSD, camera RAW and more.
Quality, size and DPI follow your preset.
engine.wic.description:
JPEG XR pictures (.jxr, .wdp, .hdp), such as HDR screenshots of Windows, to PNG, JPG and other images, with Windows' own codec.
HDR is tone-mapped so highlights keep their detail.
engine.pdfium.description: Renders PDF pages to PNG, JPG and TIFF (also multi-page TIFF and GIF) at the preset's resolution.
engine.pdfsharp.description:
Makes PDFs from images and merges, splits or cuts page ranges out of PDFs.
Also makes PDFs smaller by scaling down their pictures.
engine.rhwp.description:
Renders HWP/HWPX to PDF and converts HWP ↔ HWPX.
It also draws documents that reach PDF through HWPX (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, e-books…).
engine.unhwp.description: Extracts text, Markdown and HTML from HWP and HWPX.
engine.spreadsheet.description:
XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV into each other (XLS is read only).
One CSV per sheet.
engine.ooxml.description:
Macro-enabled files and templates (DOCM, XLSM, PPTM, DOTX…) ↔ DOCX, XLSX, PPTX.
Macros are removed.
engine.hwpx-writer.description:
Writes HWPX from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, OFD, HTML, e-books and Markdown.
The first step of turning documents into PDF without Office.
engine.docx-writer.description: Writes Word documents (DOCX) from PDF, OFD, HWP/HWPX, Markdown, HTML, spreadsheets, slides and e-books.
engine.pdf-text.description: Extracts the text of PDFs in reading order, also from two-column pages (no OCR for scans).
engine.pdf-slides.description: Turns PDFs into PowerPoint slides: each page becomes a picture on its own slide (looks like the PDF, not editable), with the page text in the speaker notes.
engine.email.description:
E-mails (EML, Outlook MSG) to HTML and text with sender, recipients and date, pictures included; attachments into a ZIP.
MSG to EML. Saved web pages (MHTML) to one HTML file with their pictures.
engine.data.description:
JSON, JSON Lines, YAML, TOML, XML and CSV into each other.
vCard contacts to CSV and back.
Comments are dropped. CSV holds tables only.
engine.vector.description: SVG and SVGZ to vector PDF, images and DXF; pictures traced into SVG; Illustrator files saved with PDF content.
engine.icns.description: macOS app icons (ICNS) from and to images.
engine.font.description: Fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
engine.cad.description: AutoCAD drawings: DWG ↔ DXF, and both to PDF, SVG and PNG.
engine.model3d.description: 3D models: GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ, 3MF and PLY into each other, FBX into any of them, and a PNG preview.
engine.geo.description:
Geospatial vector data: GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, GPX, Shapefile and CSV (longitude/latitude or WKT) into each other.
Results are WGS 84 longitude/latitude; projected Shapefiles (UTM, Web Mercator, Lambert, Albers) are converted.
engine.archive.description: Extracts ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO and more, and packs ZIP, 7Z or TAR.GZ (7-Zip).
engine.ebook.description:
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics (CBZ, CBR) to PDF, EPUB, DOCX and text.
Also documents to EPUB, EPUB to KEPUB for Kobo and PDF to CBZ.
engine.subtitle.description:
Subtitles: SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, SAMI (SMI), LRC, TTML, MicroDVD and SCC into each other, saved as UTF-8.
Korean SMI and SRT files in CP949 / EUC-KR read correctly.
engine.ffmpeg.description:
Video and audio: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and more.
Also extracts sound and subtitles, makes GIF and APNG animations and saves images as HEIC.
engine.pandoc.description:
Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown
reStructuredText, LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, MediaWiki, DocBook, Jupyter and more ↔ Markdown, HTML, DOCX and ODT
Markdown and Org → PPTX slides
engine.ghostscript.description: EPS, PostScript and older Illustrator files to PDF and images; PDF to EPS and PS.
engine.calibre.description:
Rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, CHM, PDB, RB…) and Kindle output (MOBI, AZW3).
Above the HWPX writer, it also makes the PDFs of e-books (much faster for long books).
engine.libreoffice.description:
Reads older and less common formats: DOC, PPT, Pages, Keynote, Numbers, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks, Publisher, Visio…
Also saves as DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT, ODP, OpenDocument templates and EMF.

triggers.title: Shortcuts
triggers.description: Choose how the donut toolbar opens. You can add as many gestures as you like.
triggers.macos_permissions:
Allow Dilim in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
Finder also asks for Automation permission the first time you use a selection shortcut.
triggers.linux_x11:
Drag gestures work on X11.
With file manager integration on, the first keyboard shortcut runs Thunar's Dilim action (reopen Thunar after changing it).
Hold gestures and shortcuts in other file managers aren't available. Use the Dilim menu or the drop zone.
triggers.linux_wayland:
Gestures that follow the cursor aren't available on Wayland.
Use an X11 session, or convert with the file manager menu and the drop zone.
Thunar can use the first keyboard shortcut after it restarts.
triggers.linux_wayland_experimental:
Gestures on Wayland are experimental and only work on KDE Plasma.
Dilim reads the mouse from /dev/input and a KWin script places the donut at the cursor (see INSTALL.txt). Ctrl+drag in other apps can be interrupted; use another modifier such as Ctrl+Shift if it gets in the way.
triggers.hook_stopped:
Global input detection is stopped.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.hook_linux_backend:
Gestures couldn't start because the X11 input libraries didn't load.
Use an X11 session and install libxtst6 and libxt6 (Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libxtst6 libxt6), then retry.
File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.

presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Name
presets.keep_color_profile_hint:
Available when metadata is removed.
Without it, wide-gamut photos (Display P3 from phones) can look washed out.
presets.remove_background_hint:
Makes a plain background transparent: the paper behind a signature or stamp, the backdrop of a logo.
The colour along the edge counts as background, so leave some paper around the artwork.
JPG has no transparency and gets the colour below. Not for photos of people.
presets.background_tolerance_hint:
Higher removes more, like shaded paper or smudges. Too high thins light strokes.
To keep a light fill inside an outline, turn on "Keep enclosed areas".
presets.keep_enclosed_background_hint:
Removes only the background touching the edge, so the white inside a logo stays.
Leave off for handwriting (it would keep the paper inside letters like "o").
presets.multipage_tiff: Put every file into one multi-page TIFF
presets.multipage_tiff_hint:
Each image and each PDF or TIFF page becomes a page, in order.
One PDF is enough for a multi-page TIFF.
presets.animation_speed_hint:
Shows each frame of an animation for a shorter or longer time.
Players show at most 50 frames a second, so a faster animation leaves frames out.
presets.save_every_frame: Save every frame of a video
presets.save_every_frame_hint:
A video becomes a folder with a picture of each frame instead of one still frame.
A long video gives many files.
presets.frame_estimate: One minute of 30 fps video gives {0} pictures, at most {1} per video.
presets.extract_motion_photo_hint:
A photo becomes the video saved with it: the one inside an Android Motion Photo, or the MOV next to an iPhone Live Photo.
Other pictures become a video of the still picture.
presets.merge: Merge all files into one PDF
presets.pdf_compression_hint:
Pictures are scaled down and saved as JPEG.
Text, fonts and drawings stay as they are.
If the result isn't smaller, the original is kept.
presets.pdf_ghostscript_hint:
Often smaller, but it rewrites the whole file.
The smallest result is kept.
presets.combine_pages_hint:
Puts all pages one under another in a single image.
Very long results are scaled to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
presets.combine_pages: Stack the pages into one tall image (when a PDF is converted)
presets.trim_page_margins: Cut the blank space above and below each page
presets.split_tall_image: Too tall for the format: split into several images
presets.split_tall_image_hint:
Off: a long image is scaled down to the format's limit (JPG 65,500 px, WebP 16,383 px).
On: it keeps its size and is split between pages into several files (name_1, name_2, …).
presets.leave_out_pictures_hint:
Off: the pictures are saved in a "name_files" folder next to the Markdown file and linked from it.
On: only the text, no folder.
presets.media_quality_hint:
When the new format can hold the codecs as they are (iPhone MOV → MP4), the video is only rewrapped.
No quality lost, HDR kept, done in seconds.
Small always re-encodes to make the file smaller.
presets.video_codec_hint:
H.264 plays everywhere.
HEVC files are about half the size and play on most phones, TVs and recent PCs.
AV1 is smaller still but slow to encode and needs a recent device.
A video already in the chosen codec is only rewrapped.
presets.hardware_encoding_hint:
Encodes H.264 and HEVC on the graphics chip.
Much faster and uses less power.
Slightly lower quality at the same file size.
Without a usable chip, the video is encoded as usual.
presets.combine: Put all files into one archive
presets.extract_note: Each archive is extracted into a folder of its own. Where it goes is set under Output.
presets.trace_note: Used when a picture (PNG, JPG, …) is traced into vector shapes.
presets.trace_detail_hint:
Low smooths the outlines and drops specks.
High follows the pixels closely and keeps small details.
presets.keep_dates_hint: Converted files get the created and modified dates of the original, so photos still sort by date.
presets.zip_result: Save the result as a ZIP
presets.zip_result_hint: The files of the result (a Shapefile's .shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj and .cpg) are packed into one ZIP next to the source, in place of loose files.
presets.delete_confirm: Delete “{0}”? It will also be removed from every toolbar and group.
presets.select: Select a preset to edit it
theme.title: Theme
theme.reduce_motion_hint: Recommended for older PCs. Turns off transitions and the donut's bounce.
engines.title: Conversion engines
engines.description:
Dilim picks the best available engine for each conversion.
When several can do the same job, the higher one wins.
engines.optional_description:
Large engines are only downloaded when you want them.
They are kept when Dilim updates and removed when you uninstall it.
engines.update_notice_title: Engines you installed have a new version
engines.all_description: Drag a card (or use its arrows) to change the order.
engines.lo_description:
LibreOffice can take over conversions it does more faithfully.
Without LibreOffice these switches change nothing.
engines.lo_slides_hint:
Slide backgrounds and shape positions come out as in PowerPoint.
Off: the built-in route, which can lose backgrounds or move shapes.
engines.lo_documents: Use LibreOffice for Word documents → PDF
engines.lo_documents_hint:
Laid out as in Word, including Chinese and Japanese punctuation rules.
Off: the built-in route.
engines.lo_sheets_hint:
Printed like Excel, with the print area, page setup and page breaks.
Off: the built-in route fits each sheet to the page width (page breaks kept).
engines.lo_hwp_hint:
Off by default: rhwp usually looks more like 한글.
Turn it on to compare when rhwp gets a document wrong (overlapping text, misplaced tables).
engines.package.libreoffice.name: LibreOffice (older and rare formats)
engines.package.libreoffice.description:
Needed for old or uncommon formats: DOC·PPT, OpenDocument presentations, WordPerfect, ClarisWorks·MacWrite, Apple Pages·Numbers·Keynote, Publisher·Visio and more.
Also saves as DOC·XLS·PPT·ODT·ODP·EMF and makes presentations → PDF more faithful.
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and HWP convert without it.
engines.package.pandoc.name: Pandoc (Markdown, LaTeX, Org and more)
engines.package.pandoc.description:
Adds Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown, and LaTeX, Org, AsciiDoc, Typst, Jupyter and other markup.
Also makes PPTX slides from Markdown.
Markdown and HTML → PDF, DOCX and HWPX work without it.
engines.package.ghostscript.name: Ghostscript (EPS and PostScript)
engines.package.ghostscript.description:
EPS, PS and older Illustrator files → PDF and images, PDF or SVG → EPS/PS.
SVG and PDF-compatible AI files convert without it.
engines.package.ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg (video and audio)
engines.package.ffmpeg.description:
Adds video and audio conversion, video → GIF or still image, sound from videos and GIF → MP4.
Only needed for video and audio.
engines.package.calibre.name: Calibre (Kindle and rare e-book formats)
engines.package.calibre.description:
Saves MOBI and AZW3 for Kindle and converts rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, PDB, CHM…).
EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics are read without it.

Dilim is free and open source.
A star on GitHub, a bug report, an idea or a sponsorship all help.
sponsor.title: Sponsor Dilim
sponsor.lead: Dilim is free and stays free. If you'd like to support its development, pick whichever way suits you.

sponsor.note.kofi: A one-time coffee, no account needed
sponsor.star: A ⭐ on GitHub costs nothing and helps other people find Dilim.
feedback.notice_text:
A star on GitHub helps other people find Dilim.
Problems and ideas are welcome too.
setup.title: Choose conversion engines
setup.description:
Images, PDF, Office documents, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD and 3D models already convert.
Download engines only for video and audio or rare formats.

watch.title: Watch folders
watch.description:
Files that land in these folders are converted while Dilim runs.
Downloads and copies wait until they're complete.
watch.originals_keep: Leave the original where it is
watch.originals_hint: Moving originals makes the folder work like an inbox, and files already waiting there when Dilim starts are converted too.
watch.include_placeholder: Type an extension or a name, then Enter (e.g. heic, scan_*)
watch.include_hint:
Leave empty to convert every file.
· heic → files ending in .heic
· scan → files with "scan" in the name
· * stands for any text, ? for one character (e.g. scan_*.jpg)
watch.name: Base name
watch.name_hint: The buttons add parts of the name. Leave it empty to use the preset's name.
watch.token.name: Original name
watch.rename_intro:
Set the base name, then change parts of it with rules if needed.
The preview shows the name each file will get.
watch.rename_no_steps: No changes. Pick one on the left or add one if you need it.
watch.rename_try_placeholder: Type a file name, e.g. IMG_0412.jpg
watch.include_matches: {0} file(s) in the folder match now
watch.recipes_hint: Double-click one (or press +) to add it as a rule, then change it if you like.
watch.preview_keep: The original stays where it is
watch.cli_hint: Also on the command line: filee watch <folder> --to <format>
whats_new.title: What's new in Dilim {0}
whats_new.2_0_0.browser.title: Drop straight from your browser
whats_new.2_0_0.browser.text: Hold the shortcut and drag a picture or a file link out of a web page. The donut opens, saves it and converts it.
whats_new.2_0_0.flip.title: The donut has a back face
whats_new.2_0_0.flip.text: Press Tab or turn the mouse wheel while the donut is open to flip it over to more presets.
whats_new.2_0_0.formats.title: More formats
whats_new.2_0_0.formats.text: Web archives (MHTML), OFD e-invoices, Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML and GPX maps, JPEG XR, FBX models and POTM templates.
whats_new.2_0_0.crop.title: Crop before you convert
whats_new.2_0_0.crop.text: The Crop slice opens your pictures one by one. Drag the frame, pick a ratio, and only that part is saved.
whats_new.2_0_0.theme.title: Softer, and in your colours
whats_new.2_0_0.theme.text: The donut's slices round off with Softness, and a theme.json file can recolour all of Dilim.
whats_new.2_0_0.languages.title: Dilim speaks more languages
whats_new.2_0_0.languages.text: Spanish, Hindi, Japanese and Russian join English, Korean, Chinese and Polish.
whats_new.2_0_0.more.title: And a little more
whats_new.2_0_0.more.text: Reset a single donut to its defaults, search your whole history, and convert Gujarati, Hindi or Arabic documents through LibreOffice.
pie.guide:
1. Open Dilim using Dilim Başlat.vbs. Keep it running in the tray.

2. In Explorer, select a file. Press Ctrl + Alt + Space to open Convert.

3. Ctrl + Alt + T opens Tools. Ctrl + Alt + A opens File actions.

4. For dragging: Shift = Convert, Ctrl = Tools, Alt = Actions. Start dragging the file, then hold the key and move a little. Drop on a slice.

5. Tab or the mouse wheel switches faces. Esc or the centre closes the pie.

6. From the main page: choose a mode, select a file, click Open pie menu.

7. Grey slices explain why an operation is unavailable. Install FFmpeg or 7-Zip from Engines when requested.

8. Tools ask for parameters and Run. Results go to Dilim beside the original. Move is the only action that moves originals.

Shortcuts can be changed under Shortcuts.
tool.cancelled: Cancelled. Completed outputs, if any, remain in the output folder.
tool.output.notice: Edits create new files in Dilim beside the source. Copy uses the clipboard; Share opens Windows sharing.
tool.move.notice: Move relocates the originals. Existing names are never replaced. If a batch stops, earlier moves remain completed.
tool.shelf.hint: Click to open; drag to another app. × removes the reference, leaving the file in place. Closing hides the shelf.
tool.error.time: Enter a valid range in seconds within the media duration. End must be after start.
tool.error.rectangle: The rectangle must be positive and stay inside the source image/video.
tool.error.number: Enter valid numeric values within the stated ranges.
tool.error.pages: Enter existing pages, e.g. 3,1-2,5. At most 10,000 output pages.
tool.error.missing: A source file is missing. Select it again.
tool.error.ffmpeg: Install FFmpeg from Engines to use media tools.
tool.error.unsupported: This operation does not support the selected input.
tool.error.audio: This tool requires an audio track.
tool.error.join_audio: All clips must either have audio or all be silent.
tool.error.windows: Windows sharing is available on Windows only.
tool.error.share: The Windows sharing helper is missing. Use the portable package built by build-dilim.ps1.
tool.error.conflict: A destination name already exists. Nothing is overwritten; choose another folder.
tool.error.destination: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
tool.hint.compress: Choose output format, quality and size settings below. Results are saved in the Dilim folder beside the original.
tool.hint.removeMetadata: Remove image EXIF/XMP/ICC, PDF document info, or media tags. This does not remove visible content.
tool.hint.editImage: Rotate, mirror, resize and adjust brightness, contrast or saturation. Save a new PNG.
tool.hint.annotateImage: Text is baked into a new PNG. Coordinates refer to the oriented source in pixels.
tool.hint.frameImage: Fill transparent pixels with a solid colour.
tool.hint.cropImage: Draw a crop rectangle in the crop window.
tool.hint.normalizeAudio: Normalize loudness to -16 LUFS, true peak -1.5 dB.
tool.hint.trimVideo: Enter start/end seconds. Output is an MP4 copy.
tool.hint.splitPDF: Save each page as a separate PDF.
tool.hint.organizePDF: Choose page order; omit pages to delete them from the copy. Example: 3,1-2.
tool.hint.extractArchive: Extract into a new output folder using the archive engine.
tool.hint.createPDF: Convert selected images or documents to PDF.
tool.hint.mergePDF: Move items up/down to set the order, then merge.
tool.hint.cropVideo: Enter source-pixel rectangle. Output is MP4.
tool.hint.changeVideoSpeed: Set 0.25–4×. Audio timing changes with the video.
tool.hint.joinVideos: Order clips with ↑/↓. Output is 1280×720 MP4; clips must agree about audio.
tool.hint.videoSnapshots: Save one PNG at the specified time in seconds.
tool.hint.splitVideo: Set segment duration in seconds. The last segment may be shorter.
tool.hint.audioToVideo: Create a 1280×720 orange waveform MP4 with the original audio.
tool.hint.trimAudio: Save the selected time interval as M4A.
tool.hint.createCollage: Order photos with ↑/↓. Each cell is 640×480, with a white background.
tool.hint.redactImage: Burn an opaque black rectangle into a new PNG and strip metadata.
tool.hint.redactVideo: Burn a fixed black rectangle during the specified interval. No motion tracking.
tool.hint.redactAudio: Replace the selected time interval with a 1 kHz bleep. Output is M4A.
tool.hint.share: Open Windows sharing. Choose a nearby device or app there; no file is sent automatically. Folders must be zipped first.
tool.hint.float: Keep references to files in an always-on-top shelf.
tool.hint.copy: Copy files to the clipboard, then paste in Explorer using Ctrl+V.
tool.hint.move: Select a destination folder to move the originals. Existing names are never overwritten.
tool.hint.copyPath: Copy full paths as text, one per line.
tool.hint.terminal: Open the first selected folder (or containing folder) in Terminal.
presets.video_tuning_hint: Lower CRF retains more detail and increases file size. CRF and speed use the software encoder and force re-encoding. Slower encoding may reduce size; it does not slow playback. Disable hardware encoding to use these controls.
presets.custom_pdf_hint: Uses the built-in compressor. Text and vector drawings remain intact. Only smaller image replacements are kept; the result may be unchanged if already optimized.
tool.field.maxHeight: Maximum video height (0 = source; up to 4320 px)
tool.field.fps: Frame rate (0 = source; up to 240 FPS)
tool.compress.settings_hint: Size depends on the content and chosen settings. Images become WEBP/JPG/AVIF, videos MP4 and audio M4A. Use a conversion preset to keep another format. Originals remain in place.
presets.power_two: Square size at the previous power of two
presets.power_two_hint: Compatibility option: makes the image square and may change its proportions. The independent side cap can also change proportions.
presets.legacy_quality: Set legacy video quantizer / Theora quality
presets.exact_size: Exact width / height (0 = off; setting both stretches the picture)
presets.custom_ffmpeg_hint: Output options only, for example -c:v libx264 -crf 21 -vf "scale=1280:720". They override matching preset options. The app supplies input and output paths and runs FFmpeg directly, without a shell.
presets.source_action.Archive: Move original into an archive folder
presets.source_action_hint: Keep is the default. Archive/delete run only after the whole job succeeds and outputs exist. Delete cannot be undone. A skipped or failed conversion leaves its original in place.
notice.source_action_skipped: The original was kept because a result uses its path.
engine.reason.cd_windows: Audio CD extraction requires Windows and the original disc.
about.origin_attribution: Based on Filee. Original MIT license and third-party attribution are preserved.
notice.source_action_failed: Output is ready; the source move/delete action could not finish. Check the originals.
